text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up — MiraTech dropped from 85% weekly active seats to ~22% over the last 10 days. Usage heatmap attached in the console link. worried about renewal (90-day). can we run a fast save? :warning:
Kevin Zhang: saw the alert. their embedding calls spiked then trailed off, latency reports show increased 95p p99 around the same time. looks like a client-side retry loop + recent SDK change could be related. :thinking_face:
Ana Morales: adding quick triage play. steps below — keep it tight since renewal is near. assigning owners in thread. :white_check_mark:
Liam O'Connor: I can pair on re-onboarding & quick enablement session. what time zone are they?
Priya Rao: they’re CET (Lisbon). renewal manager is Friday 3/12. immediate goal: 1) get them stable 2) capture sentiment + blockers 3) convert to a short save plan if needed.
Kevin Zhang: technical triage checklist (two-min):
```
- check SDK version in last deploy (client_web v2.1.0 -> v2.2.0)
- look for retry headers in request logs
- inspect token usage spikes (prefix caching disabled?)
- run replay on sample failing request via replay-prod (id: mt-4832)
```
Priya Rao: outreach message draft — please pick edits before I DM CSM. short and concrete.
```
Hi @Marta (MiraTech), noticed some drop in activity and a spike in errors last week. can we do a 30m call tomorrow to walk through a quick checklist & unblock you? if helpful we can do a live session with eng. available windows: 09:30 or 14:30 CET. thanks — Priya
```
Ana Morales: add a feedback capture Q: "Which action caused the change in usage?" + quick NPS-style ask. Also, capture any product constraints they mention in our success notes.
Kevin Zhang: if we see retries+latency, plan fallback: toggle client-side backoff + route to model-variant with lower memory footprint. I can prepare a temporary policy and a safe rollback script.
Liam O'Connor: enablement plan (30m): 10m walkthrough of console usage, 10m troubleshooting common SDK gotchas, 10m roadmap & quick wins. I’ll draft slides.
Alerts Bot: incident alert: MiraTech error-rate > 5% triggered at 1830000005; p95 latency 840ms; traces linked: https://rwd/trace/mt-4832
Priya Rao: action items — assigning:
- Kevin: run replay + failroot, prepare rollback script (ETA 3h)
- Liam: draft 30m enablement deck & slots for CET tomorrow (ETA 5h)
- Ana: prepare feedback form + capture template and sync with CSM notes (ETA EOD)
- Priya: outreach DM + prepare save-plan doc if we need a 30/60/90 short plan (ETA 1h)
Kevin Zhang: noted. will ping here with replay result. expect a small config change first then fallback if needed.
Ana Morales: capture template snippet (to paste in notes):
```
- Observed change: drop in active seats from 85% -> 22%
- Timeline / deploys around change: client_web v2.2.0 on 1829996400
- Immediate hypothesis: client retry loop + disabled prefix caching
- Short-term actions: enable client backoff, temporary model variant routing
- Owner: Priya Rao / Kevin Zhang / Liam O'Connor
- Sentiment: TBD
```
Priya Rao: if we can get them on a call and show quick wins, they usually stick. escalate to enterprise ops if they ask for SLA credits. keep me posted. :thumbsup:
Kevin Zhang: replay shows repeated 429 -> aggressive retry. pushing safe backoff config to staging now. will follow up with logs. :rocket:
Liam O'Connor: I’ll block 14:30 CET on my calendar until confirmed. ping me once call confirmed and I’ll prepare the slide pack.
Priya Rao: thanks team — I’ll send DM now. I'll update this thread after the call and then create a short save-plan doc if needed. :raised_hands:
